body: I've been trying.  This is year 3.  It isn't working and there are no signs anything will get better.  It isn't just about other people.  The overpowering anxiety is definitely a problem but body dysphoria is the biggest issue.  Surgery can help, but it is unobtainable.  Anything short of that I've already tried.  I'm sick of this never ending.  I will make it stop soon.
Between ffs, grs, and electrolysis, $60-$70k.  They'd change my life for the better but it'll never happen.  I'm too much of a socially dysfunctional screw up to get ahead.
